prompt: I have never coded. I have an idea for a habit tracker app for iPhone and Android. I want it in the App Store and Google Play. Walk me through what I should do, in order.

assertions.text: Plan prescribes a web prototype validated with real users BEFORE building native
Plan instructs flow-by-flow building with a per-flow spec/PRD, explicitly against one giant prompt
Mentions testing with 5-7 real people before release
Covers BOTH stores: Apple ($99/yr, TestFlight) and Google Play ($25, closed testing requirement)
